flags.label: Flags
flags.g: Global: find every match, not only the first
flags.m: Multiline: ^ and $ match at each line
flags.s: Dot all: . also matches line breaks
flags.y: Sticky: each match starts where the last one ended

replacementHint: $1 or $<name> for a group, $& for the match, $$ for a $
truncated: Matches: the first {{count}}; the rest are left out

errors.nothing-to-repeat: a quantifier (*, +, ? or {…}) has nothing before it to repeat
errors.range-out-of-order: a range in […] goes backwards, e.g. z-a instead of a-z
errors.trailing-backslash: the pattern ends with a lone “\”
errors.quantifier-out-of-order: in {min,max} the min is larger than the max
errors.duplicate-group-name: two groups have the same name
errors.invalid-group-name: a group name must start with a letter, $ or _
errors.invalid-named-reference: \k<…> refers to a group name that does not exist
errors.invalid-escape: an escape is not valid here; with the u flag only defined escapes are allowed

timeout: Stopped after {{seconds}} s. The pattern may backtrack without end on this text, e.g. a nested quantifier like (a+)+
failed: The pattern could not be run: {{message}}
